sr: DealDesk by agenthouse. From separate steps to shared progress. One enquiry, many handovers: email, CRM, conversation, Word or Excel, PDF, re-entry. It is the gaps between them. One process, one shared status: enquiry, configuration, quote, customer decision, order, confirmation. Questions and adjustments return to the same record. Your quote becomes the place to decide. Acceptance becomes an order, without re-entering line items. From enquiry to order. agenthouse.org/en/dealdesk
